seo.title: Prime Care | Clinical Diagnostics & Laboratory Equipment in Yemen
seo.description: Prime Care supplies certified hematology, blood gas, HbA1c/ACR analyzers, compatible reagents, and on-site biomedical engineering for hospitals and laboratories across Yemen.

translation.hero_subtitle: We equip hospitals and reference laboratories across Yemen with certified hematology, blood gas, and HbA1c systems—backed by continuous reagents and Sana'a-based biomedical engineers.
translation.about_heading: Biomedical engineering built for Yemen's clinical reality
translation.about_subtitle: Delivering an analyzer is only step one. Inside an ICU or reference lab, uptime depends on power resilience, uninterrupted reagents, and local calibration.
translation.about_body: Operating from Sana'a, Prime Care partners directly with hospitals and specialized laboratories across Yemen. We curate documented IVD platforms from verified international manufacturers, commissioning every instrument with on-site installation, quality-control calibration, staff training, and continuous reagent supply.
translation.about_hq_value: Sana'a — 60th Street, Al-Awlaqi Laboratories Building, Yemen
translation.about_commitments_heading: Four operational commitments for every facility
translation.commit_1_desc: Priority on battery-backed critical-care analyzers (OPTI CCA-TS2, i-SmartCare 10, i-Check 200) that keep running through power interruptions.
translation.commit_2_desc: Scheduled local replenishment for single-use cartridges, cassettes, and compatible hematology reagents across leading analyzer platforms.
translation.commit_3_desc: On-site installation, tri-level QC calibration, preventive maintenance schedules, and hands-on operator training.
translation.commit_4_desc: Every analyzer in our catalog links directly to official specifications, CE / NGSP / IFCC certifications, and operating SOPs.
translation.services_subtitle: Three integrated operational pillars covering instrument selection, reagent continuity, and long-term engineering support.
translation.srv_1_desc: Supply and commissioning of hematology, coagulation, blood gas, HbA1c/ACR, clinical chemistry, and immunoassay systems from verified OEMs.
translation.srv_1_p1: Hematology & Coagulation: PCE-210+, C-102, and Hemax series
translation.srv_1_p2: Blood Gas & Electrolytes: OPTI CCA-TS2, i-SmartCare 10, i-Check 200
translation.srv_1_p3: Diabetes, Chemistry & CLIA: A1Care, G-Series HPLC, lumiSTAT A8
translation.srv_2_desc: Original cartridges and quality-verified compatible reagents that maintain diagnostic precision while optimizing per-test cost.
translation.srv_2_p1: All-in-one CarePak cartridges and single-use blood gas cassettes
translation.srv_2_p2: B&E hematology reagents compatible with Sysmex, Mindray, Abbott, and Horiba
translation.srv_2_p3: Planned inventory scheduling to eliminate lab downtime
translation.srv_3_desc: Resident biomedical engineers delivering installation, LIS integration, calibration, and preventive service throughout equipment life.
translation.srv_3_p1: Commissioning and bi-directional LIS/HIS setup via HL7 and Ethernet
translation.srv_3_p2: Tri-level QC calibration, preventive maintenance, and rapid repair
translation.srv_3_p3: On-site operator qualification with documented Standard Operating Procedures

translation.testim_subtitle: Direct feedback from healthcare leaders who rely on Prime Care's diagnostic systems and biomedical engineering team.
translation.testim_1_text: Prime Care has proven its immense capability in equipping our laboratories with the latest technologies and best medical devices. We always trust their products, expertise, and rapid response in engineering support and periodic maintenance.
translation.testim_2_text: We are proud of our continuous partnership with Prime Care. They present complete commitment to the highest quality standards in supplying medical and diagnostic consumables, positively impacting the services we provide to our patients.
translation.testim_3_text: One of the best local companies we've worked with in hospital equipment. They stand out with high professionalism and provide immediate, reliable technical support continuously.
translation.testim_4_text: Our partnership with Prime Care has been a quantum leap in our hospital's medical equipment. Punctuality, device quality, and an integrated engineering team working with professionalism and dedication.
